about-page.title: About
about-page.description-1: Senior Frontend Developer with 4+ years of commercial experience in React and TypeScript. Before switching to development, he worked in SEO for 7 years.
about-page.description-2: From 2014 to 2021, I was engaged in analyzing websites and search results, working with the semantic core, technical optimization of websites, structure, and content. I analyzed the results of promotion and was responsible for the growth of search traffic and rankings. I worked with Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica. My experience in SEO allows me to take technical optimization and performance into account when developing web applications.
about-page.description-3: In 2021, I completed professional retraining as a frontend developer. The main stack is React, TypeScript and Next.js; I also work with Redux Toolkit, React Query, REST API and WebSockets. I develop SPA and PWA applications, including from scratch. When developing projects and functional modules from scratch, I define the application structure and use Feature-Sliced Design.
about-page.description-4: I developed complex functionality: messengers, video chats, multilingual support, integrations with maps, and WebSocket interaction with industrial equipment. I have experience in refactoring legacy code, reducing technical debt, and optimizing performance, including working with Core Web Vitals.
about-page.description-5: I take on some of the responsibilities of a technical lead: I participate in grooming and task decomposition, architectural decisions, conduct code reviews, take part in technical interviews, coordinate the work of 2–3 frontend developers, and provide mentoring.
about-page.description-6: English language - B1: I read technical documentation and conduct basic correspondence.
